QuestInfo.name: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods
QuestInfo.0: Pio wants you to help collect recycled goods.
QuestInfo.1:
You ran into Pio, who is famous in Amherst for fixing broken goods. He asks you to break down scrap boxes from around town and bring back #t4031161#s and #t4031162#s.

QuestInfo.2: You broke the boxes and collected supplies for Pio. It was fun because you found other useful items in the boxes as well.

0.0: My goodness. I've been wandering around town, and I see so many recyclable items just being thrown away! Say, can you help me collect those? \n Don't worry, I'll reward you well for your effort.

yes.0: That's right! Collect all the 'trash' around town.

no.0: Come on! Think about the planet!

yes.0: See what I'm talking about? So many recyclable items, just carelessly tossed away. Hopefully there are more people like you in the world.
